methods.reference: Au pressure scale; exact EOS citation unresolved
methods.source_location: Methods: Au powder calibrant for XRD

recalculation.notes: The article identifies Au and ruby pressure standards but does not provide the row-wise calibrant observables required for recalculation.

assessment.basis: No machine-readable P-V table is published. Analytical BM3 checkpoints and inverse-volume round trips independently verify executable transcription of the source coefficients.

primary_source_check.finding: The article supplies a complete high-spin BM3 reference branch when the reported ambient cell measurement is used for V0; the low-spin branch lacks its own V0.
primary_source_check.record_note: K0 and K0' from Results, page 2; V0 is a³ from the Methods ambient cell parameter a = 4.1996(4) Å (page 7). The paper gives no low-spin V0.

primary_data_check.finding: No machine-readable P-V table is published. Analytical BM3 checkpoints and inverse-volume round trips independently verify executable transcription of the source coefficients.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Results and Discussion, page 2; Methods, page 7; Supplementary Equations 1-5 and Figures S1-S3.
parameter_provenance.equation: Results and Supplementary Equations 1-5: third-order Eulerian finite-strain/Birch-Murnaghan high-spin reference EOS in a coupled spin model.
parameter_provenance.V0: Computed as a^3 from the Methods ambient cubic cell parameter a=4.1996(4) A; the linearized 1-sigma propagation is 3 a^2 sigma_a.
parameter_provenance.K0: Results: KT0=152.5(2.4) GPa for the high-spin state.
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Results: KT0'=4.1(0.2) for the high-spin state.
parameter_provenance.fit_relationship: The source also reports a low-spin K0 and fixed K0', but not a separate low-spin V0; that incomplete branch is not stored.

validity_notes: Pure high-spin reference branch; it is not the measured mixed-spin curve between 40 and 60 GPa.
The source reports the spin transition as a 40-60 GPa interval rather than a fitted midpoint uncertainty.
